name: Atexxo Zone 2 iPad (A16)
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 iPad (A16) is a standard iPad (A16) converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, rated for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an Ex ec ic-rated design, and the tablet runs iPadOS 27.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.certifiedAccessories: Passive stylus 'available on request' for glove operation; shoulder strap for Zone 1/2 phones and tablets. Ex rating not stated.

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least March 2030 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 11-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, True Tone, fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating (no antireflective coating or full lamination listed by Apple)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil (USB-C), Apple Pencil (1st generation) with adapter

strengths: Security updates guaranteed until at least March 2030 (Apple's minimum)
A standard iPad (A16) inside, with the same apps and Apple device management
Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 1050 g in use
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
Ex marking not yet confirmed against a published certificate
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
